body.statement: For every valid input \(\widetilde{\mathcal D}_{n,b}\) with \(0<\delta_{\mathrm{num}}\le r_{n,d,M}\), \(def:certified-finite-precision-algorithm\) returns \(\widehat C^{\mathrm{HL}}_{\delta_{\mathrm{num}}}\) satisfying \(\widehat C^{\mathrm{HL}}\subseteq\widehat C^{\mathrm{HL}}_{\delta_{\mathrm{num}}}\) and moving each endpoint outward by at most \(\delta_{\mathrm{num}}\). Its bit-operation count is \(O\bigl([dL_n^3+(n+d)L_n^2\lceil\log_2(8M/\delta_{\mathrm{num}})\rceil]b_{\mathrm{work}}^2\bigr)\), hence polynomial in \(\mathsf L_{\mathrm{in}}\) and \(\log(1/\delta_{\mathrm{num}})\). Consequently, its coverage is at least \(1-\alpha\) and its worst expected length is at most \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_{d,\epsilon,M}}E_{Q_P^{(n)}}[|\widehat C^{\mathrm{HL}}|]+2\delta_{\mathrm{num}}\lesssim_{\epsilon,\alpha}r_{n,d,M}\).
body.justification: Outward arithmetic preserves coverage only after valid exact-real roots and an error-to-root modulus exist.
body.gap: Nonmonotonicity, zero derivative, and the absent heavy score prevent certified bisection and the asserted bit bound.
body.consumer: The intended consumer remains an auditable implementation for the \(n=9915,d=8196\) application.

obligation.what_is_open: A certified outward enclosure of the actual statistical score roots and the asserted bit complexity.
obligation.obstruction: The proposed score is nonmonotone with a vanishing derivative, so score error cannot be converted uniformly to root error; the exact-real heavy score is also absent.
obligation.attempted: Coefficient and factorial magnitudes were propagated through the declared working-precision envelope, and deterministic interval inclusion was checked. The root-slope step does not follow.
obligation.partial_result:
Suppose an exact-real interval \([L,U]\) has already been defined and interval
arithmetic returns \(\widetilde L\le L\le U\le\widetilde U\) with
\(L-\widetilde L\le\delta_{\mathrm{num}}\) and
\(\widetilde U-U\le\delta_{\mathrm{num}}\).  Then deterministically
\([L,U]\subseteq[\widetilde L,\widetilde U]\), coverage is monotone under
this inclusion, and
\[
 (\widetilde U-\widetilde L)-(U-L)\le2\delta_{\mathrm{num}}.
\]
The banked coefficient bound \(|g_{Kj}|\le6^{2K}\), with \(K\le L_n\),
places polynomial/factorial intermediate magnitudes below the declared
\((en)^{8L_n}\) envelope after the frozen input-precision condition is used.
The missing score monotonicity and positive root-slope modulus prevent a
uniform outward root enclosure and the claimed bisection count.
